scope: Skull-only uncertainty comparison; all non-skull tissues, including the provisional cranial-marrow and dura proxies, are held fixed.

cases.evidence: Bevilacqua 1999 exposed living human skull absorption at 849 nm plus Matcher 1997 intact living-head scattering fit evaluated at 810 nm.
Cassano et al. 2019 Table 1 compiled 810-nm skull model.
Pitzschke et al. 2015 coefficients fitted to 808-nm cadaver-head fluence data.

interpretation_limits: The 277 emitter locations and directions are the existing Yue-derived spatial surrogate, not a measured 810-nm helmet.
Source positions are in superficial atlas voxels, so external coupling and scalp-entry Fresnel loss are outside this model boundary.
Skull label 7 varies; marrow label 11 remains the Cassano skull-like proxy because direct in-vivo cranial-marrow coefficients are unavailable.
The comparison isolates optical coefficients and does not imply wavelength-dependent biological efficacy.
